request: Review `billing.py` and tell me whether its rounding is right; don't change anything.

이 모듈 정리해 줘. 동작은 그대로 두고 중복만 없애 줘.
Make our onboarding guide easier for new hires to follow.

Go through the config loader looking for bugs, and correct whatever breaks its documented behavior.

이 PR 검토해 줘. 문제가 있으면 알려만 줘.
